response.sql: SELECT ab.translink, t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS frac FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY frac DESC LIMIT 10;
